concepts.name: 첫 교차
concepts.motif: Two beautiful ivory ceremonial swords crossed under a small emerald four-point star, polished gold blade edges and hilts, with a tiny mint ribbon. A clean symbol of the first shared battle.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / product-mockup.
Create ONE premium physical collectible enamel pin for a gaming clan's FIRST REGULAR SHARED MATCH achievement. This is one single commemorative badge, not a level series.
Concept: 첫 교차. Outer contour: a compact classic shield. Motif: Two beautiful ivory ceremonial swords crossed under a small emerald four-point star, polished gold blade edges and hilts, with a tiny mint ribbon. A clean symbol of the first shared battle.
Materials: rich emerald, pale mint and warm ivory HARD ENAMEL, substantial polished WARM GOLD metal rim and seams, realistic jewelry relief, crisp dimensional bevels and controlled highlights. Gold finish remains identical for every tier. Strong readable silhouettes at 80px, restrained bold forms. No black/silver tier rim, bronze recoloring, emoji, flat app icons, thin vector doodles, real people, watermarks, game logos or branded symbols.
The pin should have a distinct well-balanced contour and jewel-quality sculpture, fully front-facing and upright, centered LARGE on a square canvas, about 90 percent canvas height with a small even safety margin. Genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside the object. No backdrop, poster, rectangular plate, checkerboard, case, text, labels, numbers, inscriptions, letters or glow. A tasteful wearable gaming-clan collectible, not an emoji or flat icon.
